nodes.summary: Scan every production once, retaining its input exactly when it fits. Duplicates are allowed; no set insertion or uncharged deduplication occurs.
nodes.title: Charged computation of one CYK cell

nodes.summary: Scan start epsilon rules; output emptiness is a single list-tag test.
nodes.title: Charged scan for start epsilon productions

nodes.summary: Test a production output without constructing or comparing substrings. Pattern inspection is bounded (at most three cons and two symbol tags).
nodes.title: Production-output fit test for indexed CYK

nodes.summary: Two bounded array reads; invalid indices denote an empty cell.
nodes.title: CYK table lookup with empty default cells

nodes.summary: Membership in a computed cell names an actual scanned production.
nodes.title: CYK cell members come from scanned productions

nodes.summary: The charged scan has ordinary list-membership semantics.
nodes.title: Charged membership scan agrees with list membership

nodes.summary: Full membership scan, charging equality and list/control operations.
nodes.title: Charged list-membership scan

nodes.summary: The charged indexed recognizer. The nonempty branch pays for the input length scan, conversion, completed table, final lookup and membership.
nodes.title: Charged indexed CYK recognizer

nodes.summary: Build one row in increasing start-position order. Each cell is evaluated once against the already completed shorter rows.
nodes.title: Charged construction of one CYK row

nodes.summary: Every successful scan names a split in exactly the scanned interval.
nodes.title: Successful CYK split scans find a split in range

nodes.summary: Scan split positions `1,...,count`, with two table reads per split. The 16 units cover four array reads, bounds/default tests, index arithmetic, Boolean combinations and recursion control.
nodes.title: Charged scan of CYK split positions

nodes.summary: Fill rows `1,...,depth` in a fixed outer array of size `w.size + 1`. Row conversion is linear; the outer update is an indexed primitive.
nodes.title: Charged construction of the indexed CYK table

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
